title: UI refit (SolidCraft look, #655): a test plan that the refit must pass before a cut, so that a cut gate does not need a long retest

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P4
labels.description: Work the maintainer asked for, for the next cut

body:
The maintainer asked for this work on 2026-11-15:

> Associated issue, the solidcraft-ui remake; it needs to have its UI refit - properly tested, so we dont end up in 6 hours of retesting every little detail to just pass a cut gate like 0.20 did

Related: #655 (the UI refit, paused with `P?`), #658, #659, #661, #1941 (one gate step for each test binary). This issue does not start #655. It prepares the tests that the refit needs.

The problem:
- A UI refit changes almost each panel, dialog and page at one time.
- The cut of v0.20.0 needed about 6 hours of retests of small UI details before its gate was green (the maintainer's reading).
- Pixel snapshots are release-lane only (AGENTS.md "Pixel snapshots are release-lane"). They show a change, but they do not say which behaviour broke.

What is wanted:
1. An inventory of the UI tests that a refit can break: `crates/ui/tests/`, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/structural.rs`, the pixel snapshot lanes. For each test, say if it asserts behaviour (labels, roles, enabled state, commands) or layout (positions, sizes, pixels).
2. Tests that assert behaviour do not depend on the look. Find each such test that also pins a position, a size or a colour, and remove that dependency. Use AccessKit labels and roles.
3. One layout test for each page or dialog, small and named, that a refit PR updates in the same PR. A failure names the page.
4. Each refit PR changes one page or one component and its tests. The quick gate of that PR runs the UI tests of that page. No refit work waits for the cut gate to find its failures.
5. A rule for the refit PRs, proposed for AGENTS.md or `crates/ui/AGENTS.md`: a refit PR is not ready while a UI test that it touches is red or deleted, and the `#[test]` count does not go down.
6. A reading before the refit starts: the wall time of the UI suites in the batch tier and in the release tier, and the number of tests of each kind.

Open points for the worker:
- Find from the v0.20.0 cut (release PR, gate runs, fix commits on its release branch) which UI tests failed and why. Write that list in a comment here. It is the evidence for items 2 and 3.
- Say what the refit can do without the pixel snapshots.

Done means: the inventory and the v0.20.0 list are in this issue, the behaviour tests do not depend on the look, each page has its named layout test, and the rule of item 5 is in a merged process PR.
